notes: PAP reference G52/3068. Direct private-owner sale of a five-room apartment on rue du Meilet in central Evreux. The full advert states 145.62 m2 Carrez on the first floor of a three-storey residence and describes high ceilings, parquet, mouldings and marble fireplaces. Its present layout contains an entrance and corridor, separate salon and dining room, kitchen to fit with back kitchen and utility area, three large bedrooms including one with shower room, and a bathroom to fit. An individual cellar of about 30 m2 is included. The current apartment is a single whole dwelling; the advert separately identifies a possible future division into two units that has not been carried out and would require works and administrative steps. The condominium has six dwellings and thirteen lots, with no proceeding reported. Forecast charges are EUR 558 monthly, recorded as EUR 6,696 annually. DPE E is dated 30 August 2023. The detail page exposed eleven property photos; the retained URL is the first source photo.
